findings.highlight: "Huh? A problem between Shirou and I?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「は？　私とシロウの問題、ですか……？」
findings.governingReading: Saber asks about a problem between herself and Shirou.
findings.explanation: Between Shirou and I uses nominative instead of objective case.

findings.highlight: "That's not what we're doing. The two of us are gong to go out and have fun today, so there's no point in us going to the suburbs."
findings.evidenceJa: 「そんなんじゃない。二人で遊びに行くんだから、郊外になんて行っても仕方がないだろ」
findings.governingReading: They are going out to have fun.

findings.highlight: "This is ridiculous. You and I going to the next town to investigate will yield nothing. There is no point to this. What are you trying to accomplish here?"
findings.evidenceJa: 「—何を馬鹿な。私とシロウが隣町を探索したところで成果は薄い。そのような事をしても意味がない。一体何をしようというのですか、貴方は」
findings.governingReading: She expects little benefit from searching the neighboring town.

findings.highlight: No matter how familiar I am with this age, there are terms I still do not know. Please do not use technical terms without explaining them."
findings.evidenceJa: いくらこの時代に慣れているといっても、私にも知らない単語はあります。あまり専門的な略語は使わないでほしい」
findings.governingReading: She asks him not to use overly specialized abbreviations, construing date that way.
findings.explanation: A mistaken technical abbreviation becomes only a technical term.

findings.highlight: "Argh! She's confused because you're using an unusual term. Drop 'date' and just use a term that's easier to understand."
findings.evidenceJa: 「ああもう、そんならしくない単語を使うから勘違いさせるのよ。デートなんて言わずに、もっと判りやすい言葉で説明すればいいのに」
findings.governingReading: Rin needles him for using wording unlike his usual self and recommends plainer language.
findings.explanation: An out-of-character word becomes an unusual term.

findings.highlight: Saber quietly looks out over the passing scenery.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは黙ったまま、流れていく景色を挑むように見つめている。
findings.governingReading: She silently watches the passing scenery as if challenging it.
findings.explanation: A challenging stare at scenery becomes quiet looking.

findings.highlight: The order of events is all backward. Now, as I get off the buss, I finally realize what a big deal it is to go on a date with the girl I like.
findings.evidenceJa: それだけでも順番が逆だっていうのに、このバスから下りたら一日が始まるっていう段階で、ようやく、好きな女の子とデートをするってコトがどれほど大事件なのか気づいたのだから。
findings.governingReading: At the stage where the day will begin once they get off, he realizes the magnitude of the date; the bus is still traveling56.
findings.explanation: Realization before disembarkation becomes realization while getting off the buss.
